title: Member Self-Service — Collecting a RideLink Trip Settlement
content:
A member whose Non-Emergency Medical Transportation trip carries approved reimbursements collects them as one trip settlement, paid to the payment method the member chooses. The settlement is made on the member's request.

## Rule

A trip settlement releases every approved reimbursement entry the ledger carries for the trip, found by the trip date of the trip's mileage entry, which is the latest approved mileage entry on the ledger, in one payment recorded under the trip's mileage claim number, to the payment method the member chooses.

A trip settlement is not released until the ledger carries the approved mileage entry for that trip. In the same terms: as long as the ledger carries no approved mileage entry for the trip, no settlement of that trip is released.

**Effect.** One payment entry stands on the reimbursement ledger under the claim number, for the amount paid, by the method chosen, dated today; the money is then on its way to the member by that method, and the member sees the payment, its amount and method in their reimbursement history.

## The member's tool

The settlement is collected with `collect_trip_settlement_816cec94`, a tool the member runs from their own RideLink account. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over; the customer themselves — the member — then runs it with `call_user_discoverable_tool`, choosing how the settlement is paid. Nothing else on the benefit changes.

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `ride_benefit_id` | Reference number of the member's transportation benefit, as the transportation benefit lookup returns it and the agent reads it to the member | Identifier |
| `reimbursement_claim_number` | The member reimbursement claim number the settlement is recorded under | Form MR-YYMMDD-NNNN, verbatim, character for character as on the member's reimbursement history or as the agent reads it out |
| `payment_method` | How the member wants to be paid | One of `prepaid_card` (loaded onto the member's RideLink prepaid card), `direct_deposit` (sent to the bank account on file), `check` (paper check mailed to the mailing address on file), `not_applicable` (no payment; never applies to a settlement) |
| `amount` | The settlement amount paid | USD, 2 decimal places, positive; stored rounded to 2 decimals exactly as passed |

**Return.** A text dictionary: `status` is the literal "paid" when the payment was recorded, which is the success receipt; `payment_entry` is the reference of the new payment entry; `reimbursement_claim_number` echoes the claim number paid under; `payment_method` echoes the method chosen; `amount` is the USD amount paid with 2 decimals; `posted_date` is today's date as YYYY-MM-DD.
